To begin, click Next.

If you are unable to finish in one sitting, feel free to save your work and revisit later through your onboarding link. You will generate a temporary link through the link in your original onboarding email. 

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to your Tekion Implementation Manager.

This is the final step. Once you begin uploading these documents, you will not be able to Save and Resume Later.

Please upload as many as possible, but if you are unable to upload them all then please either e-mail them to Implementations@Tekion.com or save them to provide to the Implementation Manager during the Strategy and Process visit.

Thank you!
